_doc: World and competition structure: regions, tiers, wings (conferences), regular-season schedule, standings, the season-ending tournament, promotion/relegation and the season calendar. Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-league-economy.md (sys-league, sys-calendar, sys-tournament). Money values live in economy.json; clubs in clubs.json.
status: PROPOSED · TUNABLE (league-economy designer, 2026-10-25). Structure answers open-014; not approved. Names are EXAMPLE default-theme content (T5).

regions.name: Saltmarch
regions.description: Coastal free cities of salt pans, fens, chalk cliffs and smugglers' isles. Port Varrow hosts the Charter Registry and the Charterhall.

districts.name: Gullhaven Shore
districts.description: Harbours, ropewalks and shipyards around the capital, Port Varrow.

districts.name: The Brinewold
districts.description: Glaring salt pans and boiling houses in the south-west.

districts.name: Reedmere Fens
districts.description: Stilt towns, peat cuttings and eel weirs in the marshes.

districts.name: Chalkholm Cliffs
districts.description: White cliffs, beacon towers and gannet ledges.

districts.name: Tidewrack Isles
districts.description: Skerries, wreckers' coves and smugglers' steps.

districts.name: Amberstrand
districts.description: Amber beaches, dune glassworks and oyster beds on the eastern estuary.

regions.name: Emberreach
regions.description: The volcanic south. A talent pool only until M6 (open-027).

regions.name: Thornwald
regions.description: The northern forests. A talent pool only until M6 (open-027).

generationShifts._doc: Potential shifts owned by league-economy and read by the lifecycle generator (development.json potential.qualityShiftExamples).
generationShifts.worldGenFreeAgentsPerClub: Resolved by D-C: 2.5 per club (120 at 48 clubs); the number lives in development.json generation.worldGen.freeAgentsPerClub

wings._doc: Each tier splits into two wings of 8 clubs, redrawn every season by serpentine on the seed order (see regularSeason.seedOrder). Wing ids are shared by all tiers.

crossPairing._doc: k = a club's index (0-7) in its wing by seed order. Cross week 1: dawn[k] v dusk[k]. Cross week 2: dawn[k] v dusk[7-k]. In odd seasons dawn hosts cross week 1 and dusk hosts cross week 2; even seasons swap.

seedOrder._doc: Order used for the serpentine wing draw and cross pairing. Season 1: by startPrestige (desc), ties by club id. Later seasons: clubs relegated from the tier above (by their final tier-table rank), then clubs that stayed (by final tier-table rank), then clubs promoted from below (Reckoning champion first, then the Shield route).

standings.restartOnSplit: When a criterion separates part of a tied group, each remaining tied subgroup restarts from headToHeadPoints.

tables.wing: the 8 clubs of one wing; decides qualification and relegation
tables.tier: all 16 clubs; decides tournament seeding, the Shield, table prize money and promotion via the Shield route

tournament._doc: Season-ending knockout of 8 clubs per tier (O9). Single matches, no replays.
tournament.seeding: wing winners are seeds 1-2 (ordered by the tier table); the other six qualifiers are seeds 3-8 (ordered by the tier table)

promotionRelegation._doc: Applied between each adjacent pair of tiers at season end. Tier 1 has no promotion and the lowest tier has no relegation in M1.

promotionRoutes.rule: the lower tier's tier-table #1; if it is also the champion, the next-highest club in that tier table

venues.name: The Charterhall
venues.use: neutral venue for every tournament final

calendar._doc: One season = 23 played weeks plus the season-end step. Every Continue processes exactly one week. The free-agent market is open in every week.
seasonEndOrder: next_season_setup (tiers, wings, fixtures, caps, drop clause, tier minimums, grants, parachutes, budgets, patron goals, trials rookies)

matchRecords._doc: How long a played match keeps its full record. A match between two clubs other than the player's is compacted once it is compactAiMatchesAfterWeeks calendar weeks old: the processing of week w + N compacts the matches of week w, so the last N weeks always stay in full, and the season-end step compacts whatever is left for the season just played. A compacted match keeps its score, the round results, the winner, the MVP, who was named, each fighter's rounds, downs, damage and healing totals and the five each side fielded (with rows and kickoff ratings); it loses the fight inputs, per-fighter stats and round-by-round records, so its detailed report is gone. Standings, season statistics, wages, XP and every decision read only what is kept, so the value changes the size of a save and nothing in the game. The player's own matches are never compacted during the season (they stay in full for that season and the next, then go). Smaller values give smaller saves (a result is about 16 KB in full and 2 KB compacted, 405 a season) but shorten how long a report of another club's match has its detail; a value of 23 or more keeps every match of the season in full until the season end. The value is whole weeks, at least 1 (a match is never compacted in the week it is played) and at most 99. Not part of the content's save bounds (it changes no array length or counter in a save) and left out of the content hash, so tuning it does not change a career's content identity.
